name: Boba (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, blue, white and blue, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Boba: a blue shield with a white charge, with a helm, an arm-and-sabre crest and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Boba arms with helm, crest and mantling
